preserve: the AI sends the screen as JSONL lines, each an RFC 6902 change (or a list of them, or a whole spec) to { root, elements, state, reads }
every complete line is applied as it arrives; a line still being written is not applied
a bad line is left out whole and said; it never stops the lines after it
an element no line touched keeps its identity
every element is checked against its part's declared props and fixed where it can be; an unusable one is said
bound values are looked up, never evaluated
no part, prop or request is named in code: parts are rows of declared-props.json and every limit and word is data
allowed_deltas: screen-spec.mjs imports './declared-props.json' instead of '../parts/ui/declared-props.json' (the file is copied byte for byte beside it)
